summary: Shopping cart + Mollie checkout integration testing complete. Fixed 2 critical bugs (process.env → import.meta.env in CartContext.jsx and OrderConfirmationPage.jsx). All 15 backend API tests passed. Frontend cart flow fully functional: add to cart, cart overlay, localStorage persistence, checkout form, Mollie redirect, order confirmation page.

integration_issues.issue: CORS error when calling ipapi.co/json/ for language/currency auto-detection. Known issue - site falls back to browser language detection.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: CartContext.jsx line 67 - changed process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to import.meta.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (Vite compatibility)
FIXED: OrderConfirmationPage.jsx line 66 - same fix for Vite environment variable access
Cart uses localStorage with key 'chutex_cart' for persistence
Cart items keyed by product_id + variant_id combination for proper variant handling
Checkout creates real Mollie payment session (test mode) and stores order in MongoDB shop_orders collection
Order confirmation page polls GET /api/shop/order/{id} every 5 seconds to check payment status
Mollie webhook updates order status to 'paid', 'failed', 'expired', or 'canceled'
test_credentials: N/A - public shop with no authentication required
seed_data_creation: Test orders created in MongoDB shop_orders collection during testing
